about.title: About RoboNest.3D
about.description: RoboNest.3D is the 3D printing workshop of RoboNest, an Iraqi robotics and engineering brand.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.body: RoboNest started as a robotics and engineering project. RoboNest.3D is our dedicated 3D printing workshop: we design and print functional parts, robotics components, tools, educational models and decorative pieces for customers across Iraq.

sections.title: How we work
sections.body: Almost everything we sell is made to order. When you order, we confirm by phone, print your items, inspect them and hand them to our delivery partner. You pay in cash when the order arrives.

sections.title: Custom printing
sections.body: Engineers, students, makers and businesses send us their own 3D files. We review every file for printability, suggest the right material and give you a price before printing.

sections.title: Digital models
sections.body: Some of our designs are also available as downloadable STL, 3MF or OBJ files so you can print them on your own printer.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Answers about ordering, delivery, payment, custom prints and digital files.

items.a: Cash on delivery. You pay the courier when your order arrives. We do not take card or online payments.

items.q: Do you deliver to my governorate?
items.a: We deliver to all 19 Iraqi governorates through our delivery partner. The fixed delivery fee for your governorate is shown at checkout before you place the order.

items.q: How long does an order take?
items.a: Made-to-order items usually need the production time shown on the product page, plus 1–5 days for delivery depending on your governorate. In-stock items ship sooner.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
items.a: Yes, before it goes into production. Contact us on WhatsApp or through the contact page with your order number.
Upload your STL, 3MF or OBJ file on the custom printing page, choose material, colour and size, and we send you a quote. If you accept, we create the order and you pay on delivery.

items.q: How do I get my digital files?
items.a: Digital files require an account. After payment is confirmed, the files appear under Account → Downloads.

items.q: Is the price on the website final?
items.a: Yes. Our system calculates the price from the options you choose and the fixed delivery fee. We never ask for more than the total shown on your order.
PLA, PLA+, PETG, ABS, TPU and resin depending on the product. Each product page lists its materials.

delivery.title: Delivery information
delivery.description: Fixed delivery prices for every Iraqi governorate. Pay cash on delivery.
delivery.intro: Delivery is handled by our delivery partner. The fee is fixed per governorate (and, in some cities, per area) and is calculated automatically at checkout.

sections.title: When will my order ship?
sections.body: Made-to-order items ship after production and quality check. The production time is shown on each product page. In-stock items usually ship within 1–2 working days.

sections.title: What if I'm not available?
sections.body: The courier will call you. If delivery fails, we contact you to arrange another attempt.

sections.title: Digital files
sections.body: Digital 3D models are not shipped. They are downloaded from your account after payment is confirmed.

returns.title: Returns & refunds
returns.description: Our policy for made-to-order, in-stock and digital products.

sections.title: Check your order on delivery
sections.body: Please inspect your items when the courier arrives. If something is damaged or wrong, tell the courier and contact us within 3 days of delivery with photos.

sections.title: Defective or incorrect items
sections.body: If an item has a printing defect or does not match your order, we reprint it or refund it at no cost to you.

sections.title: Made-to-order and customized items
sections.body: Items printed to your specification (custom size, colour, engraving or your own file) cannot be returned for change of mind, because they are made specifically for you. Defects are always covered.

sections.title: Standard in-stock items
sections.body: Unused in-stock items can be returned within 3 days of delivery. The return delivery fee is paid by the customer unless the item was defective.

sections.title: Digital files
sections.body: Digital files are not refundable once downloaded. If a file is corrupted or missing, contact us and we will fix it.

sections.title: How refunds are paid
sections.body: Because orders are paid in cash, refunds are arranged with you directly (cash or transfer) after we receive and check the returned item.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: What personal data RoboNest.3D collects, why, and how it is protected.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: Only what we need to fulfil your order: your name, mobile number, delivery address, order details and any files you upload for custom printing. If you create an account, we also store a securely hashed password.

sections.title: Why we use it
sections.body: To confirm and deliver your orders, contact you about them, provide downloads you purchased and answer your messages. We share your name, phone and address with our delivery partner only to deliver your order.

sections.title: What we never do
sections.body: We do not sell your data, do not use advertising trackers and do not store payment cards (we only accept cash on delivery).

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: We use only essential cookies: your sign-in session, your cart, and your language preference. No analytics or advertising cookies.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: Data is stored on Cloudflare infrastructure. Passwords are hashed, sessions are protected cookies, uploaded files are private, and staff access is restricted and logged.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask us to correct or delete your data at any time through the contact page. Order records required for accounting may be kept in anonymized form.

terms.title: Terms & conditions
terms.description: The terms that apply when you order from RoboNest.3D.

sections.title: Orders
sections.body: An order is confirmed after we contact you by phone. We may decline an order that cannot be produced or delivered, in which case nothing is charged.

sections.title: Prices
sections.body: Prices are in Iraqi dinars (IQD). The total shown when you place the order — products, options, discount and fixed delivery fee — is the amount you pay on delivery.

sections.title: Payment
sections.body: Payment is cash on delivery. For digital-only orders, our team contacts you to arrange payment before files are unlocked.

sections.title: Custom prints and uploaded files
sections.body: You confirm you have the right to print the files you upload. We may refuse files that infringe others' rights or describe prohibited items such as weapons or weapon parts.

sections.title: Digital files
sections.body: Digital models are licensed for personal use. You may print them for yourself but may not resell or redistribute the files.

sections.title: Liability
sections.body: 3D-printed parts are made with care but are not certified for safety-critical use. Please use functional parts within reasonable limits.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For any question about these terms, contact us through the contact page or WhatsApp.
